# netbox_contact_assignment (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/features/contacts#contactassignments_1):

> Much like tenancy, contact assignment enables you to track ownership of resources modeled in NetBox.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_contact" "test" {
  name = "test"
}

resource "netbox_contact_role" "test" {
  name = "test"
}

// Assumes that a device with id 123 exists
resource "netbox_contact_assignment" "test" {
  content_type = "dcim.device"
  object_id    = 123
  contact_id   = netbox_contact.test.id
  role_id      = netbox_contact_role.test.id
  priority     = "primary"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `contact_id` (Number) The ID of the contact associated with the contact assignment.
- `content_type` (String) The content type of the contact assignment.
- `object_id` (Number) The ID of the object associated with the contact assignment.
- `role_id` (Number) The ID of the role associated with the contact assignment.

### Optional

- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the object, as a map of field name to value.
- `priority` (String) Valid values are `primary`, `secondary`, `tertiary` and `inactive`.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) When the contact assignment was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_updated` (String) When the contact assignment was last changed.
- `object` (String) The object of the contact assignment.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) All tags assigned to the object, including those not managed by Terraform.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_contact_assignment.example 1
```
